messages:
omar: thinking of a sunrise skate session at Cedar Bowl (7:15am) vs a leisurely pancake brunch at Maple & Co (10am). whos up? :skateboard: :pancakes:
zoe: ooh sunrise skate! bring lights and warm layers.
jake: ill do brunch. pancakes > cold concrete before coffee. :coffee: :+1:
pri: depends on weather. if drizzle - brunch. if dry - skate.
omar: fair. forecast currently clear per weather.com 
ryan: im down for skate but can only make it after 8. someone can save a spot?
ops-bot: Reminder: public parks require helmets. See policy: https://company/policies/park-gear
cafe-bot: Maple & Co offers a 10% group discount for parties of 4+. Call ahead to reserve: (555) 1212.
zoe: poll: :one: Sunrise Skate 7:15am / :two: Pancake Brunch 10am / :three: Solo Chill Night (stay-home)
omar: quick tally: 3 votes skate, 2 votes brunch, 1 night-in (still open).
jake: can yall do a later skate roll? im suspicious of 7am energy levels.
zoe: maybe keep early skate and have an optional brunch after (best of both worlds).
pri: that works. ill grab a folding stool for the park if people want to hang after skating.
ryan: tagging @omar please drop a meet pin before you head out.
omar: will post a live location in #random Saturday morning and update if rain. see ya! :sunrise_over_mountains:
